title: Normalization of the canonical topological cohomology pullback
statement: For any continuous map f of topological spaces, the canonical object cohomology pullback family satisfies IsPullback: naturality in the coefficient sheaf, compatibility with connecting homomorphisms, and the adjunction-unit normalization in degree zero.
